say:2:1131028002:1.text: If there was no treasure, my parent walked so far for nothing! How exhausting!
say:2:1131028002:1.source_cn: 要是没宝藏的话，爸爸妈妈走了那么久，路上得多累呀？！
say:2:1131028002:1.male: If there was no treasure, my parent walked so far for nothing! How exhausting!
say:2:1131028002:1.female: If there was no treasure, my parent walked so far for nothing! How exhausting!

say:3:1131028003:1.text: I must get some food for them...
say:3:1131028003:1.source_cn: 我、我得去给他们找点吃的……
say:3:1131028003:1.male: I must get some food for them...
say:3:1131028003:1.female: I must get some food for them...
